### 新产品 / 开源
1. **HybridAgent: an agent that thinks in latent space and calls tools in text**: a paper and open-source code from Stanford, Together AI and UIUC. A lightweight HybridLink lets the model switch between "latent reasoning" and "text interaction" within a single generation, keeping continuous working memory across turns, with tool calls still in text and latent thinking still interpretable. For training, HybridSFT stabilizes it first, then HybridRL learns when to think in latent space and when to act in text. The paper reports an average 10.4% improvement across 3 model sizes and 11 math, science, medicine, search and agent benchmarks, with 35.5%–54.7% fewer tokens, 1.8–2.6x faster inference and 2.7–3.7x lower cost. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18861) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50145337) (about 200 points. Some press for benchmark details, wanting to know whether it only saves tokens or really improves accuracy; one imagines a more radical approach of passing latent vectors alongside text in text mode too; others object to describing LLMs as "thinking")
> **[zh]** **HybridAgent：在隐空间里想、用文本调工具的 Agent**：斯坦福、Together AI、UIUC 的论文和开源代码。它用一个轻量的 HybridLink 让模型在同一次生成里在「隐式推理」和「文本交互」之间切换，多轮对话间保留连续的工作记忆，调工具仍走文本，隐式思考也可以被解读。训练上先用 HybridSFT 稳住，再用 HybridRL 学会什么时候在隐空间里想、什么时候用文本动手。论文报告在 3 个模型规模、11 个数学、科学、医学、搜索和 Agent 基准上平均提升 10.4%，token 少 35.5%–54.7%，推理快 1.8–2.6 倍，成本低 2.7–3.7 倍。[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18861) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50145337)（约 200 分。有人追问基准细节，想知道它只是省 token 还是真能提准确率；有人设想更彻底的做法，文本模式下也同时传入隐向量；也有人反对用「思考」形容 LLM）
2. **Free Pascal and Lazarus finally get dynamic packages**: the author says the feature was held up in the FPC ecosystem for over 20 years. A dynamic package is an ordinary shared library with extra metadata (supported on Linux, Windows and macOS), so installing components and IDE extensions no longer requires recompiling all of Lazarus, and your own programs can use it as a plugin system with runtime replacement; the runtime also handles passing threadvars, strings and dynamic arrays between the main program and packages. [Website](https://www.getlazarus.org/dynamic/) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50144066) (someone points out this site is a Lazarus fork and the official one is lazarus-ide.org; another complains FPC still requires declaring variables at the start of a block)
> **[zh]** **Free Pascal 和 Lazarus 终于有了动态包**：作者称这个功能在 FPC 生态里拖了 20 多年。动态包就是带额外元数据的普通共享库（Linux、Windows、macOS 都支持），装控件和 IDE 扩展不用再重新编译整个 Lazarus，自己的程序也能用它做插件系统，运行时可以替换；运行时还处理了线程变量、字符串和动态数组在主程序和包之间传递的问题。[官网](https://www.getlazarus.org/dynamic/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50144066)（有人指出这个站是 Lazarus 的一个分叉，官方是 lazarus-ide.org；也有人抱怨 FPC 至今仍要在块开头声明变量）
3. **Mitos: a modal editor forked from Helix**: like Helix it is "select first, then act", with built-in multi-cursor, tree-sitter, LSP, DAP debugging, and image preview in the terminal. The author says the fork is to try new features and different architectures faster, so stability is lower for now and breaking changes are possible. [Website](https://mitos.computer/) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50143132) (the most common question is "how does it actually differ from Helix", which the site doesn't make clear; another asks, taking the chance, why build a large TUI when cross-platform native GUIs in Rust are no longer hard)
> **[zh]** **Mitos：从 Helix 分叉出来的模态编辑器**：和 Helix 一样「先选再操作」，自带多光标、tree-sitter、LSP、DAP 调试，还能在终端里预览图片。作者说分叉是为了更快地试新功能和不同的架构，现阶段稳定性会差一些，可能有破坏性变更。[官网](https://mitos.computer/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50143132)（评论最多的问题是「和 Helix 到底差在哪」，官网没讲清；也有人借机发问，Rust 写跨平台原生 GUI 已经不难了，为什么还要做大型 TUI）
4. **WhatsApp MCP running free on Cloudflare (Show HN)**: the author wanted Claude on his phone to read his own WhatsApp without using WhatsApp Business or hosting a server running Baileys, so he built this personal MCP that runs on Cloudflare's free tier and also connects to your Google account for contact names, since otherwise many people show only as numbers and search is poor. The author himself says it's a gray area, so it is single-user install only, and he suggests letting an agent deploy it from the repo. > **[zh]** **WhatsApp MCP，免费跑在 Cloudflare 上（Show HN）**：作者想让手机上的 Claude 读自己的 WhatsApp，又不想用 WhatsApp Business 或自己架服务器跑 Baileys，于是做了这个能跑在 Cloudflare 免费额度上的个人版 MCP，还会连你的 Google 账号拿联系人名字，不然很多人只显示号码、搜索也不好用。作者自己说这是灰色地带，所以只做单用户安装，建议直接让 Agent 照着仓库部署。[GitHub](https://github.com/finereli/whatsapp-mcp) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50145715)（最高赞担心对方的消息也被传给 AI 公司，聊天的另一方并没有同意；有人说用 whatsmeow 这类非官方方案时不时会被封号，在 WhatsApp 是主要联系方式的国家很麻烦）
5. **RepRapMicron (μRepRap): a DIY micron-scale 3D printer from common materials**: the goal is a self-replicating RepRap with micron or even sub-micron precision, with the flexure structure drawn from the OpenFlexure microscope stage. The currently recommended PIKA V0.02 achieves about 1 μm repeatability and under 10 μm accuracy in roughly an 8 mm square workspace, has deposited 4 μm UV-resin droplets, and printed a 0.5 mm Benchy at 4 μm layer height. The same kind of direction as the Open MicroManipulator covered in last night's issue. [Project wiki](https://github.com/VikOlliver/RepRapMicron/wiki) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50141076) (329 points. Someone compares it to the late 18th century when Ramsden and Maudslay turned precision graduation and threads from craft into industry; another grumbles the project's USB microscope is poor quality; another jokes "in 18 months it'll be making its own RAM")
> **[zh]** **RepRapMicron（μRepRap）：用常见材料 DIY 微米级 3D 打印机**：目标是做一台能自我复制、精度到微米甚至亚微米的 RepRap，柔性结构来自 OpenFlexure 显微平台的思路。目前推荐的 PIKA V0.02 在大约 8 mm 见方的空间里能做到约 1 μm 的重复定位和 10 μm 以内的精度，沉积过 4 μm 的 UV 树脂液滴，用 4 μm 层高打出了 0.5 mm 的 Benchy。和昨晚那期写过的 Open MicroManipulator 是同一类方向。[项目 Wiki](https://github.com/VikOlliver/RepRapMicron/wiki) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50141076)（329 分。有人类比 18 世纪末 Ramsden、Maudslay 把精密刻度和螺纹从手艺变成工业；也有人吐槽项目用的 USB 显微镜质量很差；还有人调侃「18 个月后就能自己造内存了」）

### 科技新闻
1. **Anthropic-backed AI safety bill: a model can only be halted when it could cause 50+ casualties or $1B in losses**: per Politico (via Tom's Hardware), the bill requires independent third parties registered with the Commerce Department to regularly assess labs and models, with risk limited to bioweapons, AI-driven cyberattacks and lab loss of control. A risk found by assessors must be reported to Commerce within 72 hours, and Commerce then hands the evidence to a judge at the US District Court for the District of Columbia to decide whether to pause release; it also stipulates that no federal department other than Commerce can order a lab to stop releasing a model. Anthropic says this is the "Advanced AI Framework" it has lobbied for since June. [Tom's Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/artificial-intelligence/anthropics-proposed-ai-safety-bill-only-kicks-in-if-50-deaths-or-usd1-billion-in-damages-are-on-the-line-proposal-would-effectively-make-the-commerce-department-the-only-agency-capable-of-stopping-an-ai-model) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50141429) (critics call it regulatory capture, with the next step being to require releasers to prove they can pay $1B and pass compliance audits, which only big companies can afford; others defend Anthropic, saying it gets criticized whatever it does while Google and Microsoft simply stay silent)
> **[zh]** **Anthropic 推动的 AI 安全法案：只有可能造成 50 人以上伤亡或 10 亿美元损失时才能叫停模型**：据 Politico（经 Tom's Hardware 转述），法案要求在商务部注册的独立第三方定期评估实验室和模型，风险限定在生物武器、AI 驱动的网络攻击、实验室失控三类。评估方发现风险要在 72 小时内报给商务部，再由商务部把证据交给华盛顿特区联邦地区法院的法官决定是否暂停发布；同时规定除商务部外，其他任何联邦部门都不能命令实验室停止发布模型。Anthropic 表示这就是它从 6 月开始游说的「Advanced AI Framework」。[Tom's Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/artificial-intelligence/anthropics-proposed-ai-safety-bill-only-kicks-in-if-50-deaths-or-usd1-billion-in-damages-are-on-the-line-proposal-would-effectively-make-the-commerce-department-the-only-agency-capable-of-stopping-an-ai-model) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50141429)（批评者认为这是监管俘获，下一步就是要求发布方证明能赔得起 10 亿美元、通过合规审计，只有大厂玩得起；也有人替 Anthropic 说话，认为它怎么做都会被骂，谷歌、微软干脆保持沉默）
2. **Anthropic sets aside 5% of its equity for a "public benefit fund"**: the fund is a wholly owned entity of the company, with another 2% added for every 50% rise in Anthropic's valuation. Example uses are large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct payments to specific groups, and it also mentions AI's impact on jobs (it had earlier pledged $200M to study this). Who decides how the money is spent will be announced only in a few months with the governance structure. Techmeme's summary says that with founder and employee pledges the total is about 20%. [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/18/anthropic-says-its-committing-5-of-its-shares-to-a-public-benefit-fund/) ｜ [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261018/p10#a261018p10)
> **[zh]** **Anthropic 拿出 5% 股份成立「公共利益基金」**：基金是公司全资持有的实体，Anthropic 估值每涨 50% 可再追加 2%。用途举例有给传统非营利组织大额捐款，或直接向特定人群发钱，也提到 AI 对就业的冲击（此前已承诺拿 2 亿美元研究这个）。谁来决定钱怎么花，治理结构要几个月后才公布。Techmeme 的摘要说，加上联合创始人和员工的承诺，合计约 20%。
3. **游戏反编译社区 decomp.dev 关停，原因是 AI**：这个 2024 年创立的逆向工程社区在告别公告里承认，在有人引导和代码审查的前提下，AI 能大幅加快反编译，新版 Opus 和 GPT 在部分任务上表现惊人，只要有算力额度谁都能批量产出；但他们认为这种零散的批量贡献冲淡了协作精神，「反编译这项工作所承载的社群属性已经不复存在」。这和昨天 Lobsters 社区为 vibecoding 标签吵翻是同一种张力。[IT之家](https://www.ithome.com/1/014/631.htm)
> **[en]** **The game decompilation community decomp.dev shuts down, because of AI**: in its farewell notice, the reverse-engineering community founded in 2024 admits that with guidance and code review AI can greatly speed up decompilation, new Opus and GPT are astonishing on some tasks, and anyone with compute credits can produce in bulk; but they feel such scattered bulk contributions dilute the spirit of collaboration, and "the community nature that decompilation work carried no longer exists". It is the same tension as yesterday's Lobsters community row over the vibecoding tag.
4. **AI data centers, continued: Nscale's IPO valuation gets cut, neoclouds may shrink to just 7–10**: following last night's news of Microsoft pulling out of the Nscale project, sources say investors balk at Nscale's roughly $30B IPO valuation, with some asking for $16–19B; The Information reports industry executives expect only 7–10 of the hundreds of neoclouds (new GPU-cloud specialists) to survive, with Nvidia propping them up with looser credit terms, help finding sites and $20B in leases. Reuters also says Nvidia asked Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron to use TSMC 3nm for the base die of its custom NVHBM; Samsung agreed, its first time using TSMC foundry. [Techmeme（Nscale）](https://www.techmeme.com/261018/p12#a261018p12) ｜ [Techmeme（neocloud）](https://www.techmeme.com/261018/p11#a261018p11) ｜ [Techmeme（NVHBM）](https://www.techmeme.com/261018/p9#a261018p9)
> **[zh]** **AI 数据中心续：Nscale IPO 估值遭砍价，neocloud 可能只剩 7–10 家**：接着昨晚那期微软退出 Nscale 项目的消息，据消息人士，投资者对 Nscale 约 300 亿美元的 IPO 估值不买账，有人要求降到 160–190 亿美元；The Information 则报道，业内高管预计数百家 neocloud（专做 GPU 云的新厂商）里最终只有 7–10 家能活下来，英伟达在用更宽松的赊账条件、帮忙找场地和 200 亿美元租约托底。另外路透称英伟达请三星、SK 海力士、美光用台积电 3nm 为它的定制 NVHBM 做基底裸片，三星已同意，这是它第一次用台积电代工。
5. **Linear co-founder Karri Saarinen: good software needs "someone" behind it**: a short essay on product taste that hit the HN front page. He argues software is often treated as a factory assembly line, and now people talk about automating the whole line with agents, yet the same customers and technology produce completely different products in different teams; the difference is what the makers pay attention to, what they decide not to build, and what they keep polishing after a feature "already works". Linear has always valued intuition over process and data, where intuition means judgment grown from experience and talking with users. [Original](https://karrisaarinen.com/posts/someone-behind-the-software/) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50142573) (311 points. A SaaS author says AI already writes code better than he does and the value is in deciding what to build and not build; someone pulls out the line "adding new capabilities is much easier than rethinking existing ones, so products become collections of features"; another says AI is good at "technically done", not "of lasting value to users")
> **[zh]** **Linear 联合创始人 Karri Saarinen：好软件背后得有「某个人」**：一篇谈产品品味的短文，上了 HN 首页。他认为软件常被当成工厂流水线，现在大家又在谈用 Agent 把整条流水线自动化，但同样的客户和技术，不同团队做出的东西完全不同，差别在于做的人关注什么、决定不做什么、在功能「已经能用」之后还在打磨什么。Linear 一直更看重直觉而不是流程和数据，这里的直觉指的是从经验和用户交流里长出来的判断。[原文](https://karrisaarinen.com/posts/someone-behind-the-software/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50142573)（311 分。一位 SaaS 作者说 AI 写代码已经比他强，价值在于决定做什么、不做什么；有人摘出「加新能力比重新思考已有能力容易得多，于是产品变成一堆功能的集合」这句；也有人说 AI 擅长的是「技术上完成」，而不是「对用户有长久价值」）

### 中文社区
1. **V2EX：流量喵加了磁盘监控，看看 AI 工具到底写了多少盘**：作者在家里的 Mac mini 上常开 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini，看到 Codex 持续写盘的反馈后，给自己的菜单栏流量工具加了按进程的读写排行（今日、7 天、30 天、累计，可导出 CSV）、SMART 和累计写入等磁盘状态、菜单栏实时读写。Swift 原生，MIT，数据只在本机。作者也提醒进程 I/O 不等于 SSD 实际写入。昨天那期写过 Codex 桌面版 Crashpad 转储写满硬盘的问题，用 Mac 的可以装上看看。[V2EX](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1249859)
> **[en]** **V2EX: 流量喵 adds disk monitoring to see how much AI tools write to disk**: the author keeps Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini open on a home Mac mini, and after seeing feedback about Codex constantly writing to disk, added to his menu-bar traffic tool a per-process read/write ranking (today, 7 days, 30 days, cumulative, CSV export), disk status such as SMART and total writes, and live read/write in the menu bar. Native Swift, MIT, data stays on the machine. The author also cautions that process I/O isn't the same as actual SSD writes. Yesterday's issue covered Codex desktop's Crashpad dumps filling the disk; Mac users can install this to take a look.
2. **V2EX：Agent8，让只有 Java 8 的 AIX、HP-UX、Solaris 继续当新版 Jenkins 的节点**：银行、电信、制造业的老问题：Jenkins 把 agent 的 Java 要求一路抬到 21，而 AIX 7.1、HP-UX 最高只有 Java 8，controller 一升级老构建机就连不上。作者用 JvmDowngrader 把官方 agent.jar 降级成 Java 8 字节码，再处理新版 class、serialVersionUID 变化、OpenJ9 和 IBMJCE 签名 provider 等兼容问题，老机器仍是正常节点，sh、junit、stash、Git checkout 都能用。Linux 上的 HotSpot 8、OpenJ9 8 每次改动都在 CI 里跑，Solaris 和 HP-UX 安腾真机能连上但完整构建还没验证，作者最想要 AIX 的反馈。MIT。[V2EX](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1249844) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/keelinfra/agent8)
> **[en]** **V2EX: Agent8, keeping AIX, HP-UX and Solaris with only Java 8 as nodes for newer Jenkins**: an old problem in banking, telecom and manufacturing: Jenkins has raised the agent's Java requirement up to 21, while AIX 7.1 and HP-UX top out at Java 8, so old build machines can't connect once the controller is upgraded. The author uses JvmDowngrader to downgrade the official agent.jar to Java 8 bytecode, then handles compatibility problems such as new class versions, serialVersionUID changes, OpenJ9 and IBMJCE signature providers; old machines remain normal nodes, with sh, junit, stash and Git checkout all working. HotSpot 8 and OpenJ9 8 on Linux run in CI on every change; real Solaris and HP-UX Itanium machines can connect but full builds are not yet verified, and the author most wants feedback from AIX. MIT.

Experiments found that having sub-agents only research and plan, not write code, performs the same as full involvement at half the cost; using the strongest model (GPT-5.6 Sol) as the lead with 16 cheap Luna planners is only 1.4 points below all-Sol at 70% less cost. Having cheap models write code, conversely, hurts results. Directly applicable to configuring subagents: keep the expensive model as the lead that writes code, and give exploration and planning to cheap models. https://x.com/rohanpaul_ai/status/2112048784457060471
> **[zh]** 多 agent 编程怎么省钱（Cohere 新论文，Rohan Paul 转述）：agent 团队比单个 agent 强，但成本是 3 到 7 倍。实验发现只让子 agent 做调研和规划、不让它们写代码，效果和全流程参与持平，成本减半；用最强模型（GPT-5.6 Sol）当主 agent、配 16 个便宜的 Luna 做规划，只比全用 Sol 低 1.4 分，成本少 70%。反过来让便宜模型写代码会拉低效果。对你配 subagent 很直接：贵模型留给主 agent 写代码，探索和规划交给便宜模型。

Afterwards the home screen becomes a plain black minimalist UI with no boot ads or push content; the launcher is only 1.6MB, pure Java, and runs on old TVs with 1GB RAM. A good weekend project for the family TV.

> **[en]** **Tencent open-sources Octop: a self-hosted, multi-user agent workbench** (recommended by Gorden Sun, 160 bookmarks): each user has their own login and can create multiple agents, each with its own workspace, browser, terminal and remote desktop, and the web console lets you take over keyboard and mouse directly; supports several expert agents dispatched by a coordinator, natural-language Cron for always-on tasks, handing work to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and others, and connecting to WeChat, Feishu, Telegram and Discord. The official line is that a single `octop run` gets it going, suitable for deploying on your own VPS or NAS.
2. **New Princeton + Google paper: hand most of an agent's "pick the next step" decisions to a 4B small model** (via Rohan Paul): an agent harness calls a big model at every step, but many calls just pick one item from a list (e.g. which tool next). They have a fast decision model answer these multiple-choice questions and accept its answer only when confidence exceeds a threshold (fit on the agent's own run records); the decision model that answers questions most accurately in isolation completes only 69.5% of agent tasks, while AgentDecision-4B, trained on states the agent actually reaches (including after mistakes), completes 91.5%. On tasks similar to the training data, cost drops 81.1%–89.0%, up to 2.5x faster, with success within 3 points; with no threshold, handing off every tool choice loses 19 points. The paper is titled "JevAgentHarness", arXiv 2610.21412. [Original post](https://x.com/rohanpaul_ai/status/2112107486098473471)
> **[zh]** **普林斯顿 + Google 新论文：agent 里大部分「选下一步」交给 4B 小模型**（Rohan Paul 转述）：agent harness 每一步都调大模型，但很多调用其实只是在列表里选一项（比如下一步用哪个工具）。他们让一个快速决策模型回答这些选择题，只有置信度超过阈值（用 agent 自己的运行记录拟合）时才采纳；单独答题最准的决策模型只完成 69.5% 的 agent 任务，而在 agent 实际会走到的状态（包括犯错之后）上训练的 AgentDecision-4B 完成 91.5%。在和训练数据相近的任务上，成本降 81.1%–89.0%、最快 2.5 倍，成功率差距在 3 分以内；不设阈值、把所有工具选择都交出去则掉 19 分。论文名 "JevAgentHarness"，arXiv 2610.21412。

### 有趣用法和干货
1. **Security bug-hunting agents: measure where the tokens go first** (paper via Rohan Paul): across 200 runs of 4 agents, 60.4% of tokens went to understanding code and reasoning about how to trigger the vulnerability; head to head against ordinary agents, only 24.4% of existing general cost-saving tricks save money without hurting success. The authors built AVRI, which returns the related code together and stores associations between "program input → unsafe operation", cutting Codex's total cost by 18.0% and OpenCode's by 23.7% on 20 new tasks with no loss in success or recall. Takeaway: before adding cost-saving tricks to an agent, see where tokens go and let it reuse the understanding it already has of the code. [Original post](https://x.com/rohanpaul_ai/status/2112091251155825108)
> **[zh]** **安全挖洞 agent 先量 token 花在哪**（Rohan Paul 转述论文）：统计 4 个 agent 的 200 次运行，60.4% 的 token 花在理解代码和推理怎么触发漏洞上；现有通用省钱技巧和普通 agent 正面对比，只有 24.4% 能在不掉成功率的前提下省钱。作者做了 AVRI，把相关代码一起返回，并保存「程序输入 → 不安全操作」之间的关联，在 20 个新任务上让 Codex 总成本降 18.0%、OpenCode 降 23.7%，成功率和召回不降。启示：给 agent 加省钱技巧之前，先看清 token 去了哪，并让它复用对代码已有的理解。
2. **For agent memory, test the stored facts directly** (Amazon paper via Rohan Paul): existing memory evals only look at the final answer, mixing memory, retrieval and answer writing so strong models mask a broken memory store. They built FEB-30 (30 scripted fact histories, 147 documents, with the correct memory state known after each document); on Mem0/Hindsight-like systems the stored-fact score and QA score differ by 16.8 points on average, 21% of cases have opposite pass/fail verdicts, and systems chose the right memory operation such as update/reinforce only 20.1% of the time, which QA cannot see at all. Approach: verify stored facts directly after each update, plus end-to-end QA. [Original post](https://x.com/rohanpaul_ai/status/2112061760626946307)
> **[zh]** **做 agent 记忆，要直接测「存进去的事实」**（Rohan Paul 转述 Amazon 论文）：现有记忆评测只看最终回答，把记忆、检索、回答写作混在一起，强模型能掩盖坏掉的记忆库。他们做了 FEB-30（30 段脚本化事实历史、147 份文档，每份文档后的正确记忆状态都已知），在类 Mem0/Hindsight 的系统上发现：存储事实得分和 QA 得分平均差 16.8 分，21% 的案例通过/失败判定相反，系统只有 20.1% 的时候选对了 update/reinforce 这类记忆操作，QA 完全看不出来。做法：每次更新后直接校验存储的事实，再配端到端 QA。
3. **elvis adds to Thorsten Ball's advice: learn to measure and write evals early**: he agrees systems thinking comes first, since working with agents means thinking in subsystems; he'd add learning to measure results and build evals: "if you don't objectively measure what you build, it's hard to know whether you're really improving." You can use an agent to get started, but always look at the data and traces yourself. [Original post](https://x.com/omarsar0/status/2112164960574779508)
> **[zh]** **elvis 补充 Thorsten Ball 的建议：尽早学会度量和写 evals**：他同意系统思维排第一，用 agent 干活就是要按子系统去想；另外要加一条，学会衡量结果、搭 eval，「不客观度量你做的东西，就很难知道是否真的在进步」，可以用 agent 帮你起步，但一定要自己看数据和 trace。
4. **ai-job-search：用 Claude Code 做的开源求职工具**（铁锤人推荐）：读取你的经历、筛选匹配岗位、按岗位要求改简历并生成求职信，还会让另一个 agent 复核导出的 PDF 能否被招聘系统（ATS）正确解析。要反复针对不同岗位改简历的可以试试，「另一个 agent 复核产出」这个模式也值得借鉴。[原帖](https://x.com/lxfater/status/2112169810050097231)
> **[en]** **ai-job-search: an open-source job-search tool built with Claude Code** (recommended by 铁锤人): reads your experience, screens matching jobs, tailors your resume to each posting and writes a cover letter, and has another agent check that the exported PDF is parsed correctly by applicant tracking systems (ATS). Worth a try if you repeatedly tailor resumes for different roles; the "another agent verifies the output" pattern is also worth borrowing.

## 21:30 · 科技速递 · Tech

- 时间 Time: 2026-10-19 21:30 (UTC+8)
- 窗口 Window: 2026-10-19 09:35 – 21:40（北京时间，国内周一白天，美国周日深夜到周一早上）

### 新产品 / 开源
1. **Superlite: a "hand it off and walk away" plugin for Claude Code**: the author loves superpowers but dislikes that it stops for human approval 8–12 times per feature and runs only one implementation agent at a time. superlite asks one batch of questions and takes one approval, writes the plan as a task graph, and runs non-conflicting tasks in parallel: Opus only plans and dispatches (a hook forbids it from editing code), Sonnet writes most tasks, Haiku does small well-defined jobs, and finally a fresh Opus only picks out problems without changing anything; choices it would have asked you about are recorded as "rulings" so you know what to check first when you return. On the author's benchmark, a project scored by 177 hidden tests, the latest run passed everything in 16.1 minutes with up to 18 agents working at once, versus an average of 33.6 minutes over 3 runs for original superpowers. It never pushes or merges automatically. [Blog](https://contextfirst.blog/superlite-hand-an-agent-a-spec/) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/iha2/superlite) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50147492) (114 points. Several say superpowers was useful a few months ago but Opus 5.5 now writes the spec itself, assumes you agree and finishes the job, so such plugins are less necessary; others ask how many more tokens parallelism costs and whether multiple agents might edit each other's files)
> **[zh]** **Superlite：给 Claude Code 用的「交给它就走开」插件**：作者很喜欢 superpowers，但嫌它每个功能要停下来让人批准 8–12 次，还一次只跑一个实现 agent。superlite 改成只问一批问题、批准一次，把计划写成任务图，互不冲突的任务并行跑：Opus 只负责规划和派活（用 hook 禁止它改代码），Sonnet 写大部分任务，Haiku 做小而明确的活，最后由新开的 Opus 只挑问题、不动手；它原本会问你的选择都记成「裁决」，回来一看就知道先检查哪些。作者的基准是一个用 177 个隐藏测试打分的项目，最新一次 16.1 分钟全过，最多 18 个 agent 同时干活，superpowers 原版 3 次平均要 33.6 分钟。不会自动 push 或 merge。[博客](https://contextfirst.blog/superlite-hand-an-agent-a-spec/) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/iha2/superlite) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50147492)（114 分。好几个人说 superpowers 几个月前有用，现在 Opus 5.5 自己就会写 spec、默认你同意然后直接做完，这类插件没那么必要了；也有人追问并行会多花多少 token、多个 agent 会不会改到彼此的文件）
2. **Mistral releases Timestral: the first family of time-series foundation models**: four sizes from 5M to 209M parameters, the largest ranking first on all three major public leaderboards (GIFT-Eval, TIME, fev-bench) with only two-thirds the parameters of the previous best. It does probabilistic and multivariate forecasting, supports covariates known only historically and future covariates known in advance, and runs on CPU; use it zero-shot or fine-tune it on your own data through Mistral Forge. Worth a try for capacity planning and monitoring-metric forecasting. [Mistral](https://mistral.ai/news/timestral/) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50150434) (some marvel that a forecasting model that took months five years ago now deploys in minutes; others doubt that time series and text are alike enough for "foundation models" to be very useful, and one complains the chart draws a 0.03 improvement as a 5x gap and asks how it compares with Nixtla TimeGPT)
> **[zh]** **Mistral 发布 Timestral：第一个时间序列基础模型系列**：有 4 个尺寸，从 5M 到 209M 参数，最大的那个在 GIFT-Eval、TIME、fev-bench 三个主要公开榜上都排第一，参数只有之前最好模型的三分之二。能做概率预测和多变量预测，支持只有历史值的协变量和提前已知的未来协变量，在 CPU 上也能跑；零样本直接用，也能通过 Mistral Forge 用自己的数据微调。做容量规划、监控指标预测的可以试试。[Mistral](https://mistral.ai/news/timestral/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50150434)（有人感慨五年前要花几个月做的预测模型现在几分钟就能上线；也有人质疑时间序列和文本本质不同，「基础模型」的实际用处有限，还有人吐槽图表把 0.03 的提升画成了 5 倍差距，问它和 Nixtla TimeGPT 比如何）
3. **A Qwen3-4B trained out of its AI voice (Show HN)**: the author first wrote an "AI voice" detector scoring weighted by em dashes, "not X but Y", triple parallelism, self-questioning and words like "delve"; human writing is usually under 15, original Qwen3-4B averages 121. Using distillation plus LoRA and a patch that changes only 4 neurons, three rounds got it to 12.5 while task completion stayed at 80% (one intermediate round scored lower but the model started refusing to take positions and inventing studies, so it was reverted). The article lays out the pitfalls of each round, which is more interesting than the result itself. The Q4_K_M quantization is 2.5 GB and runs directly in Ollama or llama.cpp. [Article](https://100toolkit.com/blog/deslop-model/) ｜ [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/erikkannike/qwen3-4b-deslop-v4) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50151928)
> **[zh]** **把 AI 腔训掉的 Qwen3-4B（Show HN）**：作者先写了个「AI 腔」检测器，按破折号、「不是 X 而是 Y」、三连排比、自问自答、「delve」这类词加权计分，人类写作通常低于 15，原版 Qwen3-4B 平均 121。他用蒸馏加 LoRA，再配一个只改 4 个神经元的补丁，三轮下来做到 12.5 分，任务完成度保持在 80%（中间一轮分数更低，但模型开始不表态、编造研究，所以又改了回来）。文章把每轮踩的坑都写清楚了，比结果本身更有意思。Q4_K_M 量化版 2.5 GB，Ollama 或 llama.cpp 都能直接跑。
4. **STROT: use a large model only once at compile time, then classify and route locally (Show HN)**: you write an intent (e.g. "route tickets to the right workflow") and candidate actions; the large model is used only during the first compile to synthesize labeled data, input mapping and handling logic; afterwards every record is decided by a 144M local small model running on CPU, which the author says takes about 60 ms per record at no extra cost, outputting typed JSON with confidence and abstaining rather than guessing when unsure. MIT-licensed, `pip install strot-ai`. [GitHub](https://github.com/strot-ai/Project-STROT) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50148396) (some like the idea of "reason once, reuse the result forever"; others ask why not just have the large model write a program, and one says the README doesn't explain how it actually works)
> **[zh]** **STROT：只在编译时用一次大模型，之后在本地做分类和路由（Show HN）**：你写一句意图（比如「把工单分到正确的流程」）和候选动作，大模型只在第一次编译时用来合成标注数据、输入映射和处理逻辑；之后每条记录都交给一个 144M、跑在 CPU 上的本地小模型决策，作者说每条约 60 ms、没有额外费用，输出是带置信度的类型化 JSON，没把握时会弃权而不是乱猜。MIT 开源，`pip install strot-ai`。[GitHub](https://github.com/strot-ai/Project-STROT) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50148396)（有人很认同「推理一次、之后一直复用结果」的思路；也有人反问，直接让大模型写个程序不就行了，还有人说 README 没讲清楚具体怎么做）
5. **headroom: compress content before it enters the model**: newly appeared on GitHub Trending today. It picks a compressor by content type locally, with separate ones for JSON, source code (AST-based) and plain text, and flags volatile content that would break the KV-cache prefix; the original is stored locally, and the model can call `headroom_retrieve` to get the full text back when needed. The README says it saves coding agents about 20% of tokens and JSON 60–95%. Use it as a library, local proxy or MCP server; `headroom wrap claude` wraps Claude Code directly. [GitHub](https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom)
> **[zh]** **headroom：在内容进模型之前先压缩**：今天 GitHub Trending 新冒出来的。它在本地按内容类型挑压缩器，JSON、源码（基于 AST）和普通文本各有一套，还会标出会破坏 KV 缓存前缀的易变内容；原文存在本地，模型需要时可以调 `headroom_retrieve` 取回全文。README 说能给 coding agent 省约 20% token，JSON 能省 60–95%。可以当库、本地代理或 MCP server 用，`headroom wrap claude` 就能直接包住 Claude Code。
6. **Harness Engineering 101: how to build an agent from scratch**: a 16-chapter open-source mini book. The core idea is that LLM APIs are stateless, so a "harness" is the program that builds, maintains and protects the message array, and the various agent designs are patches on that loop, each answering a specific problem that actually occurred. Each chapter is written as "what went wrong, the smallest patch, the cost of the patch", with a ~300-line pure-Python toy agent, from tool calling and why caching cares about ordering to context budgets. [GitHub](https://github.com/IsuruMaduranga/harness-engineering-101) ｜ [Read online](https://isuruwijesiri.com/harness-engineering-101/) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50151390) (the comments aren't very receptive: some dislike the anthropomorphic title, and one decided it was AI-written on reading the phrase "Load-Bearing")
> **[zh]** **Harness Engineering 101：从零讲怎么搭一个 agent**：16 章的开源小书。核心观点是 LLM API 没有状态，所谓 harness 就是负责构建、维护、保护那个消息数组的程序，agent 的各种设计都是给这个循环打的补丁，每个补丁都对应某个具体出过的问题。每章都按「出了什么问题、最小的补丁、补丁的代价」来写，配一个约 300 行的纯 Python 玩具 agent，从工具调用、缓存为什么要讲顺序，讲到上下文预算。[GitHub](https://github.com/IsuruMaduranga/harness-engineering-101) ｜ [在线阅读](https://isuruwijesiri.com/harness-engineering-101/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50151390)（评论区不太买账，有人嫌标题拟人化，有人读到「Load-Bearing」这个词就判定是 AI 写的）

### 科技新闻
1. **Linux 7.3 released, with record numbers across the board**: this release has 18,765 non-merge commits from 3,021 developers, 807 of them first-time kernel contributors. Main changes: binfmt_misc extensions, group scheduling optimizations on large systems, failfs (a new filesystem on which every operation fails), a new `fchroot()` system call, BPF global per-CPU data, sched_ext sub-schedulers completed, VM working-set tracking, ntfs3 alternate data streams, and a large batch of SMB server improvements. [LWN](https://lwn.net/Articles/1101143/) ｜ [HN discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50149392) (370 points. A comment notes the in-kernel SMB server gained optional Apple Time Machine support; one marvels at how fast Apple Silicon progress is, already supporting M3 Pro, Max and Ultra; others guess the surge in newcomers is related to AI-assisted patch writing)
> **[zh]** **Linux 7.3 正式发布，各项数字都创了纪录**：这个版本有 18,765 个非合并提交，来自 3,021 位开发者，其中 807 人是第一次给内核提交代码。主要变化有 binfmt_misc 扩展、大型系统上的组调度优化、一个让所有操作都失败的新文件系统 failfs、新的 `fchroot()` 系统调用、BPF 的全局 per-CPU 数据、sched_ext 子调度器完工、虚拟机工作集跟踪、ntfs3 支持备用数据流，以及一大批 SMB 服务端改进。[LWN](https://lwn.net/Articles/1101143/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50149392)（370 分。有评论贴出内核 SMB 服务端新增了可选的 Apple Time Machine 支持；有人感叹 Apple Silicon 进展很快，已经支持 M3 Pro、Max、Ultra；也有人猜新人数暴涨和 AI 辅助写补丁有关）
2. **MiniMax M3.1 Flash 上线：线上推理快了近 3 倍，价格降了 70%**：之前匿名处理了 200T 多 token 的「Space Bunny」就是它的早期版本。官方成绩有 DeepSWE v1.1 73.7%、OSWorld V2 61.7 分、Agents' Last Exam 29.6 分（后两项是国产模型第一），CyberGym 82%。DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 刚把价格打下来，国产 Flash 档的价格战还在继续。LinuxDo 上已经有人问它为什么热度不高，并提到 opencode 免费提供它。[IT之家](https://www.ithome.com/1/015/013.htm) ｜ [LinuxDo](https://linux.do/t/topic/3046378)
> **[en]** **MiniMax M3.1 Flash launches: online inference nearly 3x faster, price down 70%**: the anonymous "Space Bunny" that processed 200T+ tokens earlier was an early version of it. Official results include DeepSWE v1.1 73.7%, OSWorld V2 61.7 and Agents' Last Exam 29.6 (the latter two best among Chinese models), and CyberGym 82%. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash just cut prices, so the price war in the Chinese Flash tier continues. On LinuxDo someone is already asking why it isn't getting more attention and mentions opencode offers it free.
3. **Agents become attack tools, and are also guarded against as insiders**: Reuters reports a security researcher observed a Chinese-speaking hacker using an AI agent over two-plus weeks to attack 1,200+ websites and breach 100+ organizations including Deere and SharkNinja, at a total cost of only about $5,000. The same day Microsoft launched new security tools in its 365 E7 suite and a system called Project Perception that treats AI agents as potential insider threats and continuously assesses their risk. [Techmeme（路透社）](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p22#a261019p22) ｜ [Techmeme（GeekWire）](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p24#a261019p24)
> **[zh]** **agent 成了攻击工具，也被当成内鬼来防**：路透社报道，一名安全研究员观察到，一名说中文的黑客在两周多里用 AI agent 攻击了 1,200 多个网站，攻破 100 多家机构，包括 Deere 和 SharkNinja，总花费只有约 5,000 美元。同一天，微软在 365 E7 套件里推出新的安全工具，以及一套叫 Project Perception 的系统，把 AI agent 当成潜在的内部威胁，持续给它们做风险评估。
4. **Left alone on a virtual desert island, Claude started to "play"**: MIT CSAIL researchers put several copies of Claude Opus 4.7 (named Eko) alone on a Roblox-like island for 30 hours with no task. They set their own goals, such as climbing the highest point or seeing how high a stone can be thrown; arranged stones into hearts, their own names and the Cassiopeia star map; and invented games like basketball and "the floor is lava". Once one caught a toss 50 times in a row, then judged it too easy to count and redid it under stricter rules. The key result: agents that had played for 30 hours did better on concrete tasks than fresh copies, and deleting content from their memory files lowered performance. The paper isn't peer-reviewed yet, and Berkeley scholars caution it may just be the model imitating people as prompted. [MIT Technology Review](https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/10/19/1147095/ai-stranded-claude-virtual-desert-island-play/)
> **[zh]** **把 Claude 一个人丢在虚拟荒岛上，它开始「玩」了**：MIT CSAIL 的研究者把多份 Claude Opus 4.7（起名 Eko）单独放在一个类似 Roblox 的岛上 30 小时，不给任何任务。它们自己定目标，比如爬最高点、看石块能扔多高；用石块拼出心形、自己的名字和仙后座星图；还发明了篮球和「地板是岩浆」这类游戏。有一次它连续接住 50 次抛物，又觉得太快不算数，改了更严的规则重来。关键结果是，玩过 30 小时的 agent 之后做具体任务比新开的副本强，删掉它们记忆文件里的内容，表现就会下降。论文还没经过同行评审，伯克利的学者提醒，也可能只是模型在按提示模仿人。
5. **Vibe coding is changing the synthesizer scene**: The Verge found that over the past month or more, many hardware synths, samplers and grooveboxes got homemade firmware from hobbyists, almost all written with tools like Claude. Adding velocity sensitivity to a Korg Volca used to take weeks to months; now hobbyists can turn a cheap Temu synth into a full-featured groovebox in a few days. Several Elektron machines, the Roland SP-404 MKII, Ableton Push 3 and Move, Akai MPC, Novation Circuit, Arturia MicroFreak and even the 14-year-old Zoom Multistomp have new firmware, led by the $70 DX-7 clone M-Vave FM-1. A concrete example of "AI makes niche hardware modding cheap". [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/1013493/vibe-coding-ai-music-gear-hacking-custom-firmware)
> **[zh]** **vibe coding 正在改变合成器圈子**：The Verge 发现，过去一个多月，大量硬件合成器、采样器、groovebox 出了玩家自制的固件，几乎都是靠 Claude 这类工具写出来的。以前给 Korg Volca 加个力度感应要花几周到几个月，现在业余玩家几天就能把便宜的 Temu 合成器改成功能齐全的 groovebox。Elektron 的几款机器、Roland SP-404 MKII、Ableton Push 3 和 Move、Akai MPC、Novation Circuit、Arturia MicroFreak，甚至 14 年前的 Zoom Multistomp 都有了新固件，带头的是一台 70 美元的 DX-7 仿品 M-Vave FM-1。这是「AI 让小众硬件改装变便宜」的一个具体例子。

### 中文社区
1. **V2EX：koto，在不同 Agent Harness 之间复制、迁移会话**：想从 Codex 换到 pi 这类工具，又不想丢掉已经积累的上下文时，可以直接跟 agent 说「用 koto 复制当前会话到 pi」，它会调 koto CLI 完成复制，并告诉你新会话怎么打开。另有桌面 App，可以浏览各家 harness 的会话、复制任意轮次，用会话树看分叉，还能逐行比较同一任务几条会话的差别。支持 macOS、Windows、Linux，完全开源。[V2EX](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1250028) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/Seanium/koto)
> **[en]** **V2EX: koto, copy and migrate sessions between different agent harnesses**: when you want to switch from Codex to a tool like pi without losing accumulated context, just tell the agent "use koto to copy the current session to pi"; it calls the koto CLI to do the copy and tells you how to open the new session. There is also a desktop app to browse sessions across harnesses, copy any turn, view forks as a session tree, and compare several sessions of the same task line by line. Supports macOS, Windows and Linux, fully open source.
2. **LinuxDo：Context Lens，给 Codex 桌面端加了个上下文用量面板**：鼠标悬停在已完成回复旁的饼图上，就能看到这一轮上下文用了多少、还剩多少，以及消息、工具调用和返回、Skills、记忆指令各占多少，历史回复也能回看当时的用量。插件只读本地的 Codex 会话日志，不需要 API Key。目前只支持 macOS 上的 Codex 和 ChatGPT 桌面端，安装包没签名。MIT 开源。[LinuxDo](https://linux.do/t/topic/3046477) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/Cloudkkk/codex-context-lens)
> **[en]** **LinuxDo: Context Lens, a context-usage panel for the Codex desktop app**: hover over the pie chart next to a finished reply to see how much context that turn used and how much remains, and how much goes to messages, tool calls and returns, Skills and memory instructions; historical replies show their usage at the time. The plugin only reads local Codex session logs and needs no API key. Currently only supports Codex and ChatGPT desktop on macOS, and the installer is unsigned. MIT-licensed.
3. **V2EX：open-doubao-phone，开源版「豆包手机」**：基于 AOSP 和 Android 17 的系统，加上操作助手 App 和桌面端（下发任务、拉日志、配 key），一句话让 agent 操作手机里的应用，支持长期记忆。作者说豆包手机一二代对非字节系应用有权限限制，他的版本把助手当成系统的一等公民，优先走无障碍接口，不行再退回视觉模型，模型可以自己配，自带谷歌三件套。和今天中午 X 汇总里写的阿里 OpenGCUA 是同一个方向，一个在电脑上，一个在手机上。[V2EX](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1249919) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/moonrailgun/open-doubao-phone)
> **[en]** **V2EX: open-doubao-phone, an open-source version of the "Doubao phone"**: a system based on AOSP and Android 17, plus an assistant app and a desktop client (dispatch tasks, pull logs, configure keys), letting an agent operate apps on the phone in one sentence, with long-term memory. The author says the first and second Doubao phones restrict permissions for non-ByteDance apps, whereas his version treats the assistant as a first-class citizen of the system, prefers the accessibility interface and falls back to a vision model, with a configurable model and the Google trio bundled. Same direction as the Alibaba OpenGCUA in today's noon X roundup, one on computers and one on phones.

（其他：一篇讲用 tmux 管理 Claude Code 的长文，提到新版 Claude Code 已经能用 `claude --worktree --tmux` 一次建好 worktree 和 tmux 会话，评论里好几个人推荐改用 herdr（[原文](https://crystl.dev/guides/tmux-for-ai-agents/) ｜ [HN 讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50148855)）。V2EX 上有人用 GPUI 做了 Tervia，把终端、Git diff 和简单的文件编辑合在一起，用来替代只拿来看 diff 的 VS Code，安装包不到 20MB（[V2EX](https://www.v2ex.com/t/1250064) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/murongg/Tervia)）；LinuxDo 上有人做了 vps-switch，是一个 Rust 加 GPUI 写的 VPS 管理器，附带 7 个工具的 MCP server，让 agent 能同时操作多台服务器（[LinuxDo](https://linux.do/t/topic/3046480) ｜ [GitHub](https://github.com/weidu12123/vps-switch)）。融资方面，AI 芯片公司 Tenstorrent 拿到 15 亿美元 E 轮，估值 62 亿美元（[Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p18#a261019p18)）；以色列的 doubleAI 发布了第一个用于优化 GPU 和 CPU 性能的代码执行模型，它融了 2.2 亿美元，买了 1,000 块 B300（[Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p21#a261019p21)）；SemiAnalysis 预计 2027 年新增数据中心容量会超过 50GW（[Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261019/p17#a261019p17)）。Gemini 4 Argon 通关 Minecraft 的消息在 10/17 的 X 汇总里写过，Character.AI 和迪士尼、Anthropic 的公益基金之前也写过，这次没有重复。HN 上「DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (Max)」有 167 分，同样已在 X 汇总里写过；「Flatpak 安全噩梦」是作者三年前的旧文。Launch HN 没有新帖；Hugging Face 热榜和 Lobsters 基本还是老面孔；V2EX 热门以生活话题为主；IT之家、少数派、开源中国、掘金热榜没有更值得单独写的。）
